target: docs/GOVERNANCE.md as practised in round 2; roles/run_roles.sh; ops/evo_daemon.sh; work/ layout
claim: The round-1 governance problems (F-0008) are documented in README but not fixed, and round 2 adds new loopholes. (1) The builder writes and grades its own acceptance tests. GOVERNANCE gives the test suite and credibility gates to the verifier. Yet the gates that 'prove' the F-0003 / F-0004 fixes (gate1d_stick_memory.py, gate2_fsu.py) were written, run and declared PASS by the integrator, in the engine folder gpufe/ and in the same commit as the fixes. The roles receive the claim through pi_updates.md, which the integrator also wrote. (2) There is no feedback loop on findings. There is no work/requests/ folder and no CR-*.json. None of F-0001..F-0010 has a status or reply field. The 7 round-1 change requests in work/board/r0001/redteam.json were never registered. 'Red team is scored by confirmed findings (verifier reproduces them)' therefore has no mechanism. (3) Round order is not as documented. run_roles.sh starts verifier, safety and red team in parallel ('&' ... 'wait'). The red team cannot attack this round's verifier and safety verdicts (GOVERNANCE step 5 comes after steps 3-4), and the verifier cannot reproduce this round's findings. (4) The HOLD gate was bypassed without a record. The verifier's round-1 verdict is HOLD, and GOVERNANCE.md:49 says the next round starts only without HOLD / open-critical; F-0001 was critical and has no closure. Round 2 started with no DECISIONS.md entry overriding the HOLD. (5) Evidence is lost on re-runs. evo_daemon.sh re-launches a role every 5 min while its verdict file is missing, and run_roles.sh:18 truncates <round>.session.json and <round>.err with '>'. A crashed attempt's log is overwritten, while any partial findings it wrote stay in work/findings/ with no trace of which attempt made them. A role that writes its verdict first and then keeps working counts as done. (6) The folder layout in GOVERNANCE.md is not the real one: it lists work/roles/<role>/, work/archive/, work/requests/ and work/ISSUES.md, but the real folders are work/agents/<role>/ and docs/ISSUES.md, with no archive or requests folder. The permission patterns are relative paths, so they silently stop matching if a role's shell changes directory (observed this round, r0002_notes.md). Roles also have WebFetch, so unpublished data can leave the machine in a URL; no rule forbids it.
evidence: docs/GOVERNANCE.md:22 (verifier owns tests / gates), :24 (reply in the finding), :28-36 (layout), :42-49 (round order, HOLD rule), :59 (red team scored by confirmed findings); git log 77b7596 (fix + gate1d + gate2 in one integrator commit); work/board/r0002/pi_updates.md:8-15; Glob work/{requests,archive,roles}/** -> no files; grep '"status"' work/findings/F-000*.json -> none; work/board/r0001/redteam.json change_requests (7 entries); work/board/r0001/verifier.json:4 '"verdict": "HOLD"'; grep HOLD docs/DECISIONS.md -> no override entry; roles/run_roles.sh:10-12 (relative patterns, WebFetch), :17-21 ('&', '>' redirection), ops/evo_daemon.sh:12-14.
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited lines; ls work/; git show --stat 77b7596.

fix_options.option: Gates are owned by the verifier: move gate scripts to a verifier-owned folder (or let the verifier sign each gate report: script hash + result hash); the integrator may propose gates via CR but not declare a PASS

Run the round in two phases: verifier + safety first, then red team on their verdicts; the integrator registers every change request as CR-*.json and adds status / reply to every finding before the next round; the PI records any HOLD override in DECISIONS.md

Logs: append with a timestamped attempt id ('>>' or <round>.<attempt>.session.json); record the attempt id in every file a role writes; fix GOVERNANCE.md layout to the real folders; use absolute-path permission patterns; drop WebFetch or restrict it to literature domains

summary_zh: 第一輪指出的分工問題，只在說明文件中被承認，並沒有被修正，而且第二輪又多出新的漏洞。（一）寫程式的人自己出考題、自己打分數：依規定，驗證關卡應由驗證者負責，但證明問題「已修正」的兩道關卡，是由整合者撰寫、執行並宣布通過的，而且和修正放在同一次提交中。（二）發現沒有回覆機制：沒有變更請求資料夾，第一輪的 10 項發現都沒有狀態或回覆，第一輪提出的 7 項變更請求也沒有登記。（三）三個角色同時執行，所以紅隊無法檢查同一輪驗證者與安全守門者的判定，驗證者也無法重現紅隊的發現。（四）第一輪驗證者的判定是「暫停」，依規定不能進入下一輪，但第二輪照樣開始，決策紀錄中沒有任何說明。（五）角色當機後重跑時，舊的執行紀錄會被覆蓋，證據因此消失。（六）治理文件寫的資料夾結構和實際不符；權限設定使用相對路徑，切換目錄後就會失效；各角色都可以連到外部網址，沒有規定禁止把未發表的資料送出去。
